# Method CreateFinishingParameter

#### CreateFinishingParameter(DocumentId, PdmMinorRevisionId)

Creates a finishing parameter into a document

##### Declaration

```
[OperationContract]
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 20, 296, 0)]
ElementId CreateFinishingParameter(DocumentId inDocumentId, PdmMinorRevisionId inPdmMinorRevisionId)
```

##### Parameters

|  Type |  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | --- | 
   
|  DocumentId |  inDocumentId |  Id of the container document  |  
 
|  PdmMinorRevisionId |  inPdmMinorRevisionId |  Minor revision of the finishing document to reference  |  

##### Returns

|  Type |  Description |  
| --- | --- | 
   
|  ElementId |  Id of the created parameter.  |  

##### Remarks

StartModification(string, bool) and EnsureIsDirty(ref DocumentId) must be called before calling this method.
 
This method is available since v7.19.400.160
